segments.name: Psychedelic-based therapeutics
segments.description: Clinical-stage biopharmaceutical developing nature-derived psilocybin treatments for mental health disorders, including adjustment disorder in palliative care.
segments.evidence: The Company is a multi-asset, vertically integrated biopharmaceutical company focused on psychedelic-based therapeutics, with pharmaceutical-grade drug candidates manufactured through its investment in PsyLabs.

revenueModel.text: Investors fund the company through equity and convertible debt; it has no approved products and has generated no revenue.
revenueModel.evidence: To date, no products have been approved for commercial sale and Psyence has not generated any revenue.
